tasks.label: Compilar e Executar Minha Refeicao (Terminal)
tasks.command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin | Out-Null; javac -encoding UTF-8 -d bin (Get-ChildItem -Recurse src/*.java).FullName; java -cp bin Main

tasks.label: Executar Demonstracao Guiada (Principal + FA1, FA2, FA3)
tasks.command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin | Out-Null; javac -encoding UTF-8 -d bin (Get-ChildItem -Recurse src/*.java).FullName; java -cp bin Main --demo
